title: Integrability of the Radon–Nikodym density minus one
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $ rac{d\mu}{d
u}\colon \Omega 	o  br$ denote the real-valued Radon–Nikodym density of $\mu$ with respect to $
u$. Then the function $x \mapsto  rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x) - 1$ is integrable with respect to $
u$.
